### Why Recruitment Agencies Need Dedicated Candidate Verification Platforms


Recruitment agencies operate in a unique bind: they are responsible for the quality of candidates they place, but they do not control the candidates’ honesty. When a placed candidate turns out to have a fake degree, fabricated work history, or a criminal record, the agency’s reputation takes the hit, not just with that one client, but across the market.


The numbers make the risk clear. According to[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files H1 FY26](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , **4.33% of white-collar hires** have discrepancies in their background checks.[OnGrid’s FY 2024-25 data](https://cxotoday.com/media-coverage/over-3-6-lakh-individuals-had-at-least-one-background-check-fail-in-fy-2024-25-ongrid/) found **3.6 lakh individuals** with at least one verification failure. An[EY India study](https://www.ey.com/en_in/newsroom/2025/05/employment-fraud-on-the-rise-ey-study-calls-for-tech-enabled-vigilance-in-hiring-amidst-rising-risks-across-sectors) based on 1 million+ screenings found **32% of discrepant IT profiles cited fake employers** and **45% of IT candidates were moonlighting** .[HireRight’s 2026 report](https://www.hireright.com/blog/indias-hiring-landscape-2026-employment-risk-identity-fraud-ai-shift) found **74% of Indian employers** have discovered identity fraud during hiring.


For a recruitment agency placing 500 candidates per year, even a 4% discrepancy rate means **20 candidates with fabricated records** passing through your pipeline, any one of whom could damage a client relationship worth lakhs.

Factor In-House HR Team Recruitment Agency

**Client expectations** Internal tolerance for process delays Clients expect pre-verified candidates delivered fast


**Margin pressure** Verification cost absorbed in HR budget Verification eats into per-placement margins (often 8–15% of CTC)


**Speed requirement** Can tolerate 3–7 days Clients want candidates within 48–72 hours; verification must be near-instant


**Candidate variety** One industry, consistent roles Multiple industries, roles from junior to CXO, IT to retail


**Compliance burden** One company’s DPDP Act obligations Must comply on behalf of multiple client companies


### What Recruitment Agencies Need From a Verification Platform


1. **Speed** — results before the candidate’s submission deadline, not after the client has already made a decision
2. **Low per-candidate cost** — verification must be affordable at agency margins (Rs. 500 or less per candidate)
3. **No minimum volumes** — agency hiring volume fluctuates by quarter and client
4. **Government database accuracy** — agency reputation depends on verified facts, not candidate-provided references
5. **PDF reports** — shareable verification documents that agencies can attach to candidate profiles for clients
6. **Self-serve** — recruiters at the agency should run checks themselves, not wait for account managers
7. **Multi-client flexibility** — same tool works for IT, retail, BFSI, and healthcare placements

## #2 AuthBridge — Best Enterprise BGV for Large Staffing Firms


**Pricing:** Custom enterprise | **Agency Rating:** 4.5/5

Their iBridge platform offers 140+ integrations, 600+ court district coverage, field agents across India, and dedicated account management. According to their[Workforce Fraud Files H1 FY26](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , they track discrepancy patterns across 20+ industries, giving agencies data-backed verification for every sector their clients operate in.


**Best for agencies that:** Place 1,000+ candidates/year across diverse industries, serve enterprise clients that require comprehensive BGV (criminal, education, field, global), and can afford enterprise pricing.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** AuthBridge covers every check type including criminal and education. But 2–7 day turnaround and enterprise pricing make it impractical for agencies that need to verify candidates before client submission deadlines. SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 delivers the core identity + employment checks in 2 minutes.


## #3 SpringVerify — Best HRMS-Integrated Platform for Agency Workflows

Free trial available.


**Best for agencies that:** Work with mid-market clients using Indian HRMS platforms and want verification that integrates directly into client HR systems, with published and predictable pricing.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** SpringVerify’s HRMS integration feeds results directly into client systems. But at Rs. 799–Rs. 1,599 per candidate vs. Rs. 499, and with 2–5 day turnaround vs. under 2 minutes, SalaryBox Verify is faster and more margin-friendly for agencies.

According to[CXOToday](https://cxotoday.com/daily-news/top-ai-powered-background-verification-platforms-transforming-recruitment-in-india/) , IDfy is among the top AI-powered BGV platforms transforming recruitment in India. They process 100M+ verifications annually across BFSI, e-commerce, and tech.


**Best for agencies that:** Place candidates remotely across India, need liveness verification to prevent identity swaps, and serve BFSI or fintech clients requiring AI-powered fraud detection.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** IDfy’s AI catches identity swaps and forged documents. But for the employment and identity checks that catch the majority of placement fraud, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 is more directly targeted and transparently priced.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### 1. What is the best candidate verification platform for recruitment agencies in India?


**SalaryBox Verify** is the best platform for recruitment agencies because it delivers government-verified identity and employment checks in under 2 minutes at Rs. 499 per candidate, fast enough to verify before submitting profiles to clients, and cheap enough to run on every candidate without destroying agency margins. Start at[salarybox.in/verify](https://salarybox.in/verify/) .


### 2. Why do recruitment agencies need verification platforms separate from their clients?


Agencies bear reputational risk for every candidate they place. If a candidate with fake credentials passes through, the client blames the agency. Having your own verification platform, rather than depending on the client’s BGV, lets the agency catch problems before submission, differentiate with government-verified profiles, and protect client relationships proactively.


### 3. How much should a recruitment agency spend on candidate verification?


Verification should cost less than **0.5% of the placement fee** . At Rs. 499 per candidate (SalaryBox Verify), verification costs ~0.1–0.2% of a typical placement fee. Enterprise platforms at Rs. 1,500–Rs. 5,000 per candidate cost 1–5% of the fee, too expensive for agencies to run on every candidate.


### 4. Can agencies share verification reports with clients?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify generates PDF reports with masked sensitive data and timestamps for every check. Agencies can attach these to candidate profiles as a value-add. This differentiates the agency: clients trust agencies that submit government-verified profiles over those that submit unverified resumes.


### 5. How fast should candidate verification be for recruitment agencies?


Client submission deadlines are typically **24–72 hours** after sourcing a candidate. Verification must complete within this window, ideally in minutes, not days. SalaryBox Verify’s under-2-minute government database checks let recruiters verify during the interview debrief, before the submission goes out.


### 6. What verification checks are most important for recruitment agencies?


**PAN verification** (confirms legal identity) and **UAN/EPFO past employment history** (verifies actual employers, dates, and detects moonlighting) are the two most important checks. Together they catch the most common placement frauds: fake identity, fake employers, inflated tenure, and moonlighting. On SalaryBox Verify, both cost Rs. 499 per candidate.


### 7. Do recruitment agencies need criminal record checks for every candidate?


No. Criminal record checks are essential for placements in finance, security, healthcare, childcare, and other trust-sensitive roles (typically 20–40% of an agency’s placements). For the majority of placements, PAN + EPFO verification catches the most common frauds. Add criminal checks only when the role or client requires them.


### 8. How do agencies handle verification for multiple clients with different requirements?


Use a **tiered approach** : run SalaryBox Verify (Rs. 499, instant government checks) for every candidate, then add client-specific deep checks (criminal, education, global screening) only when the client’s requirements demand them. This ensures every candidate gets baseline verification while accommodating different client standards.


### 9. Can verification help agencies win new clients?


Yes. Agencies that include government-verified PDF reports with candidate submissions demonstrate a higher standard of due diligence. In competitive pitches, saying “every candidate we submit is verified against EPFO government records” is a tangible differentiator that clients value, especially after they have experienced a bad hire from a non-verifying agency.


### 10. What is the ROI of candidate verification for recruitment agencies?


At a 4% discrepancy rate, an agency placing 500 candidates/year will encounter ~20 candidates with fabricated records. Even one bad placement can damage a client relationship worth Rs. 5–10 lakh in annual revenue. SalaryBox Verify’s cost to verify all 500 candidates: Rs. 2,49,500 — a 15–30x ROI compared to the client revenue at risk.
